Maya: Quick micro-poll — which editor do you secretly prefer? And as a bonus: sandwich or poke for lunch today? Reply with emoji or short answer.
Carlos: VS Code all the way :vscode: — sandwich for me :sandwich:
Asha: neovim forever. sandwich is meh, I'll take poke :bento:
Tom: Emacs > everything. sandwich pls :bread:
Priya: IntelliJ/JB tools for work, but VS Code at home. sandwich :thumbsup:
Maya: If you pick vim/neovim you owe the team a jar of pickles. stakes are high :pickle:
Carlos: ugh pickles. I'll bring chips instead if I lose :chip:
lunch-bot: Poll logged — Editors: VS Code (Carlos, Priya), Neovim (Asha), Emacs (Tom). Lunch: Sandwich x3, Poke x1.
Asha: also, tiny side-poll — best goofy model nickname? mine: "muffin-model" :cake:
Tom: calling it "old-timer" (for my relic prompts) :smile:
Priya: "stickerbot" is mine — deserves a sticker pack :stuck_out_tongue:
Maya: Final tally: sandwich wins 3-1. Ordering now. Meetup 12:15 in kitchen.
Carlos: Sweet, i'll swing by with chips.
Tom: I'll bring those pickles (tragic fate) :crying_cat_face:
Maya: Awesome, thanks all :tada:
Priya: See you there!
